title: b7z9.16(c): wire DAO timing into C rpl node loop
description: Parent: project-LICHEN-worker6-b7z9.16 (spec 09 14.2 R-09-017..019: initial 0-2s random after join; retry 4/8/16s exponential; refresh 900s). Wire lichen/subsys/lichen/rpl/rpl_dao_timing.c exports into the C rpl node runtime loop (find the DAO send site: lichen/subsys/lichen/rpl/router.c or node loop; no caller exists today outside lichen/tests/rpl_dao_timing/main.c). Keep rpl_dao_timing constants as the single oracle. Add/extend a host-buildable CMake test (pattern: lichen/tests/rpl_dao_timing or tests/rpl_dodag) driving the loop with injected time asserting initial 0-2s window, 4/8/16 retries, 900s refresh. Build with the host CMake test path (no west needed). Independently landable; Rust and Python mirrors are sibling children.
